spoken: the problem happens when a customer upgrades their plan in the middle of a billing cycle and here is the exact sequence first the customer opens uh the billing page and clicks upgrade second the payment is processed correctly and the confirmation page appears third um the invoice is generated but it uses um the old plan price instead of the new one fourth the next renewal charges the customer um the old price again and fifth support has to manually issue a refund uh and fix the subscription record this has now happened to at least twelve customers this month so i would call it high priority and i think the root cause is the cached plan lookup in the invoice service
intended:
The problem happens when a customer upgrades their plan in the middle of a billing cycle. Here is the exact sequence:
1. The customer opens the billing page and clicks upgrade
2. The payment is processed correctly and the confirmation page appears
3. The invoice is generated but it uses the old plan price instead of the new one
4. The next renewal charges the customer the old price again
5. Support has to manually issue a refund and fix the subscription record
This has now happened to at least 12 customers this month, so I would call it high priority, and I think the root cause is the cached plan lookup in the invoice service.

spoken: for anyone who needs to rotate uh the api keys here is the process the steps are one generate a new key in uh the dashboard under settings two update the secret in the vault with the new value three redeploy the staging environment and check that the health endpoint still returns okay four repeat er the same for production during the low traffic window um and five revoke the old key only after you have confirmed that nothing is still using it please do not skip uh the last step because we have been bitten by that before and also post in the channel when you start and when you finish
intended:
For anyone who needs to rotate the API keys, here is the process. The steps are:
1. Generate a new key in the dashboard under settings
2. Update the secret in the vault with the new value
3. Redeploy the staging environment and check that the health endpoint still returns OK
4. Repeat the same for production during the low traffic window
5. Revoke the old key only after you have confirmed that nothing is still using it
Please do not skip the last step, because we have been bitten by that before, and also post in the channel when you start and when you finish.

Runbook for restarting the queue workers

Before you begin, check the dashboard to see how many jobs are waiting. If the backlog is larger than a few thousand, notify the team channel so that nobody is surprised by delays.

To restart the workers, connect to the management console and select the worker group. Choose the drain option first, which allows running jobs to finish. Wait until the active count reaches zero, and then restart the group.

After the restart, watch the queue for ten minutes. The backlog should begin to shrink within a few minutes. If it does not, check the worker logs for connection errors and escalate to the on-call engineer.
